anomaly_label: Increased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Heater element temperature climbs steadily 273.9 -> 278.5 °C over 20 min while reboiler T703 stays flat at ~50.4 °C
Reboiler vessel temperature static ~50.3-50.4 °C, no boil-up progression
Distillate flow essentially zero (~0.005) throughout; total reflux with FT704 ~1.9
Column section temperatures flat (~39/36 °C), no separation profile developing
Column dP steady ~1.1-1.5 mbar, no change in vapour traffic

args.missing_evidence: Heater duty/setpoint and reflux-valve state, plus a composition sample of distillate/bottoms; also whether T703 thermocouple is reading correctly (independent reboiler temperature) to distinguish a stalled boil-up from a stuck/drifting sensor.
